\begin{example} \end{example}[Nonnegative holomorphic bisectional curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0226 1. ch13:13.5\group Kahler Curvature Conditions

Nonnegative holomorphic bisectional curvature is preserved by Kähler--Ricci flow whenever the maximum principle applies. \end{example}
Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:chow-ii-system-wmp Its Kähler curvature cone is closed, convex, unitary-invariant, and preserved by the reaction ODE, so the bundle maximum principle applies.

□
